report.title: Underscore character stripped out in memo, replaced with italics
report.body:
### Describe the bug

Existing memos have underscore characters stripped out in a memo and replaced with italics on the adjoining word.

in edit mode the underscores are still there.







### Steps to reproduce

See above

### The version of Memos you're using


v0.25.0

### Screenshots or additional context

_No response_

preconditions: a memo exists whose text contains underscore characters that are part of words or surround words, e.g. snake_case style text
steps: Click the memo editor input on the home page
Type a memo containing underscores, such as: my_variable_name and other_word_here
Click the Save button to create the memo
Look at the rendered memo in the memo list
Click the edit option from the memo's menu to open edit mode
Look at the text in the editor
plan.expected: the rendered memo shows the underscore characters literally (for example 'my_variable_name' with visible underscores) and no words are shown in italics
plan.reported_actual: In the rendered memo the underscore characters are stripped out and the adjoining word is shown in italics; in edit mode the underscores are still present
missing: What exact memo text triggers the issue (the report gives no example content)?
Exact steps to reproduce; the report just says 'See above'
Are the affected memos pre-existing (imported/migrated) or created in the current version?
assumed: the example text 'my_variable_name and other_word_here' is representative of the reporter's content
assumed: creating a new memo with such text reproduces the behavior the same way as existing memos
plan.summary: Underscores in rendered memo are removed and adjacent word italicized, though edit mode shows them
